# Practical considerations

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Common fitting problems

### Convergence issues

-   Poor starting values
-   Flat likelihood surfaces
-   Numerical instabilities
-   Parameter bounds

------------------------------------------------------------------------

### Identifiability problems

-   Multiple solutions
-   Correlated parameters
-   Insufficient data
-   Model overparameterization

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Solutions

-   Multiple starting points
-   Profile likelihood
-   Data augmentation

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Troubleshooting guide

### If Optimization fails

1.  Check starting values
2.  Verify parameter bounds
3.  Examine objective function
4.  Try different algorithms
5.  Simplify the model

------------------------------------------------------------------------

### If parameters are unidentifiable

1.  Fix some parameters
2.  Use additional data
3.  Add regularization
4.  Consider model reduction
5.  Use prior information

------------------------------------------------------------------------

### If results are unrealistic

1.  Check model assumptions
2.  Verify data quality
3.  Examine residuals
4.  Test sensitivity
5.  Consider alternative models

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Best practices

### Before fitting

-   Understand your data
-   Check model assumptions
-   Set realistic parameter bounds
-   Prepare multiple starting values

------------------------------------------------------------------------

### During fitting

-   Monitor convergence
-   Check for local minima
-   Validate results
-   Document everything

------------------------------------------------------------------------

### After fitting

-   Assess goodness of fit
-   Quantify uncertainty
-   Test sensitivity
-   Validate predictions

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Software recommendations

### R Packages

-   [`bbmle`](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/bbmle/vignettes/mle.pdf): Maximum likelihood in R
-   [`rstan`](https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/rstan/vignettes/rstan.pdf) and [`cmdstanr`](https://mc-stan.org/cmdstanr/): Bayesian inference in R
-   [`pomp`](https://kingaa.github.io/pomp/vignettes/getting_started.html): Particle filtering
-   [`brms`](https://paul-buerkner.github.io/brms/index.html): Bayesian inference in R
-   [`nimble`](https://r-nimble.org/): Bayesian inference in R

------------------------------------------------------------------------

### Specialized Software

-   [`Stan`](https://mc-stan.org): Probabilistic programming
-   [`OpenBUGS`](https://sourceforge.net/p/openbugs/wiki/Home/): Bayesian inference
-   [`JAGS`](https://mcmc-jags.sourceforge.io): Bayesian analysis
-   [`PyMC`](https://www.pymc.io/welcome.html): Bayesian inference in Python
-   [`Turing.jl`](https://turinglang.org/): Bayesian inference in Julia
